plan.purpose: Validate a local, reproducible external ball-specific detector training path. One epoch is a feasibility run, not model selection or a final release.
plan.export: Only manifest-verified images marked labeled, with a finite in-image ball box and no ignore regions. Unknown/unannotated ball frames excluded, never fabricated as negatives. Preserve original pixels. All game splits disjoint. Test exported separately but run_test=false.
plan.limitations: Short, previously accessed external clips from only three games; ball-present-only export cannot validate absence behavior. Full-frame downsampling may erase small balls. Feasibility success does not establish accuracy, suitability for final inference or competition eligibility.

training.limitation: Short, previously accessed external clips from only three games; ball-present-only export cannot validate absence behavior. Full-frame downsampling may erase small balls. Feasibility success does not establish accuracy, suitability for final inference or competition eligibility.
